# Wibeset

> Wibeset is a small studio in Saguenay, Québec, Canada, that builds web and mobile products — the calm, fast, private kind — and ships them itself.

Wibeset was founded by Dominic Martineau, a full stack developer based in
Saguenay, Québec. The studio works in English and French, and releases the
products below under its own name.

Key facts:

- Location: Saguenay, Québec, Canada.
- Founder: Dominic Martineau.
- Working languages: English and French. The site exists in both (/ and /fr/).
- Contact: hello@wibeset.ca
- Focus: web and mobile applications, plus native macOS apps.
- Four of the seven products below are not released yet; three are available now.

## Products

- [Puuunch](https://wibeset.ca/#projects): A fast, beautiful timesheet for freelancers and small teams. Log time, review the week, and send it for approval, without the accounting-software feel. Web application. Not released yet.
- [Noue](https://wibeset.ca/#projects): A collaborative memory for small teams, built on one principle — one interaction, one note. A person is a name and a timeline. Made for small businesses, agencies and consultants who find HubSpot and Salesforce far too complex. Explicitly not a CRM. Web application. Not released yet.
- [The Chirp League](https://wibeset.ca/#projects): Fantasy hockey pools with built-in trash talk — draft real NHL players, track live standings against live NHL data, and chirp your rivals in one place. Web application, with iOS and Android builds. Not released yet.
- [Reliure](https://reliure.me): A quiet reading journal for iPhone — keep every book, know where you are, remember what moved you. iOS app. Available now.
- [TopNHLPlayers.com](https://topnhlplayers.com): The top ten players of every NHL season for the last ten years, ranked season by season. Website. Available now.
- [Luere](https://luere.app): A free, native macOS app that shrinks, converts, crops and resizes images, with a live before/after compare slider. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF and GIF. Requires macOS 26 or later. Everything runs on the user's Mac — nothing is ever uploaded. Available now.
- [Luere Icon Studio](https://luere.app/icon-studio/): A free, native macOS app that turns a single logo into every icon and favicon size for web, macOS, iOS and Windows, including favicon.ico, PWA maskable icons, .icns and Xcode AppIcon.appiconset bundles. Requires macOS 14 or later. Runs entirely on the user's Mac. Available now.
